बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम चटपटी और बड़ी खबर! 🎬✨
रामायण फिल्म के स्टार्स रणबीर कपूर, साई पल्लवी और रवि दुबे ने हाल ही में Amitabh Bachchan के शो Kaun Banega Crorepati में धमाकेदार एंट्री ली। 🔥
शो के दौरान अमिताभ बच्चन ने तीनों कलाकारों का गर्मजोशी से स्वागत किया और इस महाकाव्य का हिस्सा बनने पर गर्व जताया। 👏
साई पल्लवी ने सीता का किरदार निभाने पर बात करते हुए कहा कि उन्होंने इस रोल के लिए कोई दिमाग नहीं लगाया, बल्कि Sita Maa से प्रार्थना करके आगे बढ़ीं और सीखने की कोशिश की। 🙏
एक अन्य प्रोमो क्लिप में कलाकारों का भव्य स्वागत हुआ और अमिताभ बच्चन ने बचपन की दिवाली का एक मजेदार किस्सा भी शेयर किया, जिसे सुनकर सब हंस पड़े। 😂
डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari की यह फिल्म दो भागों में आएगी, जिसका पहला पार्ट 5 नवंबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगा। 🍿
यह दिवाली स्पेशल एपिसोड 29 और 30 अक्टूबर को रात 9 बजे Sony Entertainment Television और SonyLIV पर प्रसारित होगा। 📺
क्या आप Ramayana फिल्म देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Sai Pallavi says she ‘prayed to Sita Maa’ before playing her in Ramayana during KBC appearance with Ranbir Kapoor
ctx.summary: On Kaun Banega Crorepati, Sai Pallavi said she approached her role as Sita without calculations and praying for guidance.
ctx.text:
The stars of Ramayana — Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Ravie Dubey — appeared on Amitabh Bachchan's Kaun Banega Crorepati to promote their upcoming film. During the interaction, Amitabh warmly welcomed the three actors and expressed pride in the fact that they are starring in the epic. Sai Pallavi also spoke about playing Sita and how she approached the role.
During the show, Amitabh asked the actors what came to their minds when they were approached to play their respective roles. Sai Pallavi recalled her reaction, saying that she did not approach the role with calculations but instead allowed it to teach her.
She said, "I didn’t want to use my head this time. Every time when I play a character, I think what can I give to that character, but this was the first time when I thought - 'What can I get for playing a role like that of Sita Maa? Like what knowledge will I gain from this?' So, I wanted to keep the process transparent. I didn’t want to think anything about it. I prayed to Sita Maa and went forward with it."
In another promotional clip from the show, Ranbir, Ravie and Sai make a grand entry, with dancers welcoming them amid chants of Jai Shri Ram’. Later, Ranbir asked Big B to share his one memory of celebrating Diwali as a kid. The veteran actor shared one playful memory and said, “Diwali ki ek he yaad hai, ki agar bagal vale ke yaha bomb fata hai, toh humara bomb usse zyada tez hona chahiye (I remember one thing about Diwali: if a firecracker goes off at a neighbour’s place, ours has to be even louder).”
Amitabh’s confession makes Ranbir laugh out loud and clap, while Ravie Dubey and Sai Pallavi also burst into laughter.
The Diwali special episode of Kaun Banega Crorepati 18 is scheduled to air on October 29 and 30 at 9 pm on Sony Entertainment Television and SonyLIV.
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Hindu epic. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The ensemble cast also includes Sunny Deol as Hanuman, Arun Govil as Dasharath and Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi.
It is produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations. The first instalment is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on November 5, 2026.
